# CasaHogar Casarino

<!-- Generated from manifest.json by scripts/build.js. Do not edit by hand. -->

Appliance and furniture retailer based in Montevideo with an online store on the Wix platform. Sells kitchen and home appliances, furniture, bedroom items, TV and audio and phones. States free interior shipping through DAC and in-store pickup at its Montevideo location.
